jobs.title: Environmental Scientist
jobs.description:
Environmental Scientist

Terra Solutions - Townsville, QLD
Location: Townsville
Employment Type: Casual, Part-time or Full-time
Experience Level: Graduate to early-career level; 1 - 3 years preferred

1. About Us

Terra Solutions is a local Townsville-based consultancy providing a wide range of environmental and services across North Queensland. You will be part of a highly talented team dedicated to delivering high-quality environmental services.
We work across various environmental sectors, offering practical and scientifically robust solutions to support environmental management, water resources, land development, natural resource projects, and major infrastructure. Our team values collaboration, integrity, and a balanced, supportive work environment.
As our project portfolio grows, we are seeking an environmental scientist to join our team.

2. The Role

This is a great opportunity for a graduate or early-career environmental scientist looking to build broad consulting experience across a diverse range of projects. Depending on your experience, you will be involved in:
·        Undertaking environmental fieldwork, including surface water monitoring and sampling.
·        Assisting with environmental and aquatic ecology field programs across North Queensland.
·        Managing, reviewing and interpreting environmental monitoring data.
·        Preparing technical reports, monitoring reports and other project documentation.
·        Assisting with environmental assessments, compliance monitoring and environmental management projects.
·        Working with GIS, Excel, R, Python and/or other data analysis tools where applicable.
·        Liaising and working collaboratively with environmental scientists, clients and other project specialists.
·        Developing your technical and consulting skills through mentoring and practical project experience.

3. About You

We’re looking for individuals who are passionate about environmental science, enjoys a mix of field and technical work, and is keen to continue developing their skills. Ideally, you will have:
·        A degree in Environmental Science, Ecology, or related fields.
·        Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
·        Good written and verbal communication skills.
·        Strong attention to detail and an ability to work effectively as part of a team.
·        A willingness to undertake fieldwork and travel throughout North Queensland.
·        A current Australian driver's licence.
Experience in consulting is desirable but not essential. Skills or experience in any of the following would be highly regarded:
·        Surface water or groundwater monitoring and sampling.
·        Aquatic ecology or ecological field surveys.
·        Environmental data analysis and interpretation.
·        GIS.
·        R, Python and/or advanced Excel.
·        Environmental monitoring or compliance reporting.

4. Why Join Terra Solutions?

At Terra Solutions, you will:
·        Join a small, local and highly capable team where your contribution genuinely matters.
·        Gain hands-on experience across a wide variety of environmental projects and industries.
·        Receive mentoring and technical support from experienced environmental scientists and hydrogeologists.
·        Develop both field and technical consulting skills.
·        Work on projects ranging from environmental monitoring and management to major infrastructure, water-supply investigations and natural resource projects.
·        Have opportunities to develop your career in areas that align with your interests and strengths.
·        Be part of a supportive and collaborative workplace that values flexibility and genuine work-life balance.

5. How to Apply

Please send your CV to admin@terrasolutions.com.au.
We welcome applications from undergraduates through to candidates with several years of relevant experience.

jobs.title: Environmental Science Expert (Masters/PhDs)
jobs.description:
Environmental Science Expert (AI Training)

About The Role

What if your expertise in climate modeling, ecology, or sustainability could directly shape how AI understands and reasons about the world's most urgent environmental challenges? We're looking for Environmental Science experts — Masters and PhD holders — to help build and train cutting-edge AI models by developing rigorous, real-world scientific problems that push the boundaries of machine reasoning.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role designed for working scientists and researchers who want to apply their domain expertise in a new and impactful way. Full training support is provided — no prior AI experience needed.

Organization: Alignerr
Type: Hourly Contract
Location: Remote
Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

Design, solve, and review advanced environmental science problems with real-world relevance and scientific rigor
Apply deep expertise in climate modeling, ecology, sustainability, or related disciplines to craft complex, nuanced problem statements
Collaborate asynchronously with AI researchers and fellow domain experts to strengthen AI model reasoning and accuracy
Evaluate AI-generated scientific content for accuracy, depth, and clarity
Ensure all deliverables meet high standards of scientific precision and communicative clarity
Work independently on task-based assignments at your own pace and schedule

Who You Are

Holds a Master's or PhD in Environmental Science or a closely related field
Deep expertise in one or more areas: climate modeling, ecology, sustainability, environmental policy, or earth systems science
Comfortable coding in Python or R for research, data analysis, or modeling
Exceptional written communicator — you can explain complex science clearly and precisely
Detail-oriented, self-motivated, and reliable when working independently
Fluent in English and based in the U.S., Canada, U.K., Australia, or New Zealand

Nice to Have

Prior experience with data annotation, evaluation systems, or AI training workflows
Background in scientific writing, peer review, or research publication
Experience working across interdisciplinary teams or in collaborative research environments
Familiarity with AI tools or large language model evaluation as an end user

Why Join Us

Work on cutting-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs and AI teams
Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you
Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, intellectually stimulating work
Apply your scientific expertise to a domain that matters — helping AI reason better about climate, ecology, and the environment
Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch
